# traceforce_cloud_connection_deployment (Resource)

The collector Terraform created for a cloud connection. Destroy clears it in Traceforce. Needs a Traceforce backend with the cloud-connection deployment routes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "traceforce_cloud_connection_deployment" "this" {
  connection_id = traceforce_cloud_connection.this.id
  collector_id  = aws_lambda_function.collector.arn
  identity_id   = aws_iam_role.collector.arn
  regions       = ["us-east-1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collector_id` (String) AWS: Lambda ARN. Microsoft 365: Function App resource ID.
- `connection_id` (String) ID of the traceforce_cloud_connection.
- `identity_id` (String) AWS: IAM role ARN. Microsoft 365: managed identity object ID.

### Optional

- `regions` (List of String) AWS Regions the collector reads (AWS only, at least one). Removing it keeps the stored regions; the collector's uploads may replace them.

### Read-Only

- `deployed_at` (String) When Traceforce recorded this deployment.
